description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the Sign Up Credit Screen, implementing a pixel-accurate layout with absolute positioning using Stack and Positioned widgets. It includes visual elements like headers, input fields, labels, buttons, and social sign-in options, primarily for the sign-up process in a mobile application.

classes.name: SignUpCredit081Screen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that builds the sign-up credit screen, featuring precisely positioned UI elements for a pixel-perfect design.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree with a fixed width layout, using Stack and Positioned for absolute placement of UI elements according to a Figma design.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Returns a custom header bar widget for the screen title and back navigation.

methods.name: inputRect
methods.description: Creates a styled box representing a static, pixel-perfect input field.
